title: LSU vs UARK: tuition, size, location

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Louisiana State University Health Sciences Center-Shreveport and University of Arkansas at Little Rock are both public institutions, but they differ significantly in size and location. LSU Health Sciences Center-Shreveport, located in Shreveport, has a very small undergraduate enrollment of 21 students, reflecting its specialized focus. In contrast, the University of Arkansas at Little Rock, situated in Little Rock, serves a much larger undergraduate population of 4,949 students. Additionally, while LSU Health Sciences Center-Shreveport does not list an in-state tuition figure, the University of Arkansas at Little Rock charges $9,748 for in-state tuition. These differences highlight the distinct roles and scales of the two universities.
